3914-serge-panine-volume-01.creator: Georges Ohnet, v1
3914-serge-panine-volume-01.description: A book by Georges Ohnet, v1. We are now trying to release all our books one year in advance of the official release dates, leaving time for better editing. Please be encouraged to send us error messages even years after the official publication date.

73052-greatest-wonders-of-the-world-as-s.title: Greatest Wonders Of The World As Seen And Described By Famou
73052-greatest-wonders-of-the-world-as-s.creator: Unknown
73052-greatest-wonders-of-the-world-as-s.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. We were surrounded by five and twenty boatmen, each of whom exerted himself to get our custom: these were the _ciceroni_ of the Blue Grotto. I chose one and Jadin another, for you must have a boat and a boatman to get there, the opening being so low and so narrow that one cannot enter unless in a very small boat.

arxiv-2106-14513.title: Timing of the solar wind propagation delay between L1 and Earth based on machine learning
arxiv-2106-14513.creator: C. Baumann, A. E. McCloskey
arxiv-2106-14513.description: Abstract Erroneous GNSS positioning, failures in spacecraft operations and power outages due to geomagnetically induced currents are severe threats originating from space weather. Having knowledge of potential impacts on modern society in advance is key for many end-user applications. This covers not only the timing of severe geomagnetic storms but also predictions of substorm onsets at polar latitudes.

arxiv-2206-04775.title: Polyhedral compactifications of Bruhat-Tits buildings of quasi-reductive groups
arxiv-2206-04775.creator: Dorian Chanfi
arxiv-2206-04775.description: Abstract Given a quasi-reductive group G G over a local field k k , using Berkovich geometry, we exhibit a family of G ⁡ ( k ) G(k) -equivariant compactifications of the Bruhat-Tits building ℬ ⁡ ( G , k ) \mathcal{B}(G,k) , constructed and investigated by Solleveld and Lourenço.

arxiv-2305-05363.title: Metal-poor stars observed with the Magellan Telescope. IV. Neutron-capture element signatures in 27 main-sequence stars Thanks: This paper includes data gathered with the 6.5 m Magellan Telescopes located at Las Campanas Observatory, Chile. Metal-poor stars observed with the Magellan Telescope. IV.
arxiv-2305-05363.creator: Mohammad K. Mardini, Anna Frebel, Leyatt Betre, Heather Jacobson, John E. Norris, and Norbert Christlieb
arxiv-2305-05363.description: Abstract Based on high-resolution spectra obtained with Magellan/MIKE, we present a chemo-dynamical analysis for 27 near main-sequence turnoff metal-poor stars, including 20 stars analyzed for the first time. The sample spans a range in [Fe/H] from − 2.5 -2.5 to − 3.6 -3.6 , with 44% having [Fe/H] < − 2.9 <-2.9 .

arxiv-2403-00488.title: Inferring solar differential rotation and viscosity via passive imaging with inertial waves
arxiv-2403-00488.creator: Tram T. N. Nguyen
arxiv-2403-00488.description: Abstract Abstract The recent discovery of inertial waves on the surface of the Sun offers new possibilities to learn about the solar interior. These waves are long-lived with a period on the order of the Sun rotation period ( \sim 27 days) and are sensitive to parameters deep inside the Sun.

arxiv-2410-06891.title: On the oxygen p p states in superconducting nickelates
arxiv-2410-06891.creator: Frank Lechermann
arxiv-2410-06891.description: Abstract While key attention in transition-metal oxides is usually devoted to the d d states of the transition-metal ion, the O ( 2 ​ p ) (2p) states usually also carry important physics. We here examine these p p states in representatives of the novel superconducting nickelates, as described in realistic dynamical mean-field theory.

arxiv-2410-11877.title: A Framework for Collaborating a Large Language Model Tool in Brainstorming for Triggering Creative Thoughts
arxiv-2410-11877.creator: Hung-Fu Chang, Tong Li
arxiv-2410-11877.description: Abstract Creativity involves not only generating new ideas from scratch but also redefining existing concepts and synthesizing previous insights. Among various techniques developed to foster creative thinking, brainstorming is widely used. With recent advancements in Large Language Models (LLMs), tools like ChatGPT have significantly impacted various fields by using prompts to facilitate complex tasks.

arxiv-2504-06264.title: Enhancing 3D Reconstruction for Dynamic Scenes
arxiv-2504-06264.creator: Jisang Han Honggyu An Jaewoo Jung Takuya Narihira Junyoung Seo, Kazumi Fukuda Chaehyun Kim Sunghwan Hong Yuki Mitsufuji Seungryong Kim
arxiv-2504-06264.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Jisang Han Honggyu An Jaewoo Jung Takuya Narihira Junyoung Seo, Kazumi Fukuda Chaehyun Kim Sunghwan Hong Yuki Mitsufuji Seungryong Kim. In this work, we address the task of 3D reconstruction in dynamic scenes, where object motions frequently degrade the quality of previous 3D pointmap regression methods, such as DUSt3R, that are originally designed for static 3D scene reconstruction.

arxiv-2508-19660.title: Arbitrary Precision Printed Ternary Neural Networks with Holistic Evolutionary Approximation Thanks: Manuscript received March 6, 2025, revised July 17, 2025 , accepted August 20, 2025. ( Corresponding author: V. Mrazek, e-mail: mrazek@fit.vutbr.cz ). Thanks: This work was supported by the Czech Sci
arxiv-2508-19660.creator: Vojtech Mrazek, Konstantinos Balaskas, Paula Carolina Lozano Duarte, Zdenek Vasicek
arxiv-2508-19660.description: Abstract Printed electronics offer a promising alternative for applications beyond silicon-based systems, requiring properties like flexibility, stretchability, conformality, and ultra-low fabrication costs. Despite the large feature sizes in printed electronics, printed neural networks have attracted attention for meeting target application requirements, though realizing complex circuits remains challenging.

arxiv-2510-14765.title: Inpainting the Red Planet: Diffusion Models for the Reconstruction of Martian Environments in Virtual Reality
arxiv-2510-14765.creator: Giuseppe Lorenzo Catalano, Agata Marta Soccini
arxiv-2510-14765.description: Abstract Space exploration increasingly relies on Virtual Reality for several tasks, such as mission planning, multidisciplinary scientific analysis, and astronaut training. A key factor for the reliability of the simulations is having accurate 3D representations of planetary terrains. Extraterrestrial heightmaps derived from satellite imagery often contain missing values due to acquisition and transmission constraints.

arxiv-2511-17251.title: Basically Trapped A General Equilibrium Approach to the Undersupply of Basic Research in Free Markets Working Paper
arxiv-2511-17251.creator: Lucas D. KONRAD
arxiv-2511-17251.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Lucas D. KONRAD. In this paper I propose a micro-based innovation driven general equilibrium growth-model allowing for endogenous entry and exit as well as three different types of research. I make the novel distinction between three types of firms, namely basic and applied research where applied research is again differentiated into high and low type research to account for a heterogeneous firm environment. I further propose a new and flexible way to model basic research spillovers in this model class.

arxiv-2512-20535.title: ARBITER: AI-Driven Filtering for Role-Based Access Control
arxiv-2512-20535.creator: Michele Lorenzo Reply Spike Turin, Italy mi.lorenzo@reply.it Idilio Drago University of Turin Turin, Italy idilio.drago@unito.it Dario Salvadori Reply Spike Milan, Italy d.salvadori@reply.it Fabio Romolo Vayr Reply Spike Turin, Italy f.vayr@reply.it
arxiv-2512-20535.description: Abstract Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) struggles to adapt to dynamic enterprise environments with documents that contain information that cannot be disclosed to specific user groups. As these documents are used by LLM-driven systems (e.g., in RAG) the problem is exacerbated as LLMs can leak sensitive data due to prompt truncation, classification errors, or loss of system context.

arxiv-2601-06482.title: Spectral Distribution of one-dimensional Photonic Quasicrystals: The Role of Irrational Numbers
arxiv-2601-06482.creator: Hui Quan, Wei Si, Kai Jiang
arxiv-2601-06482.description: Abstract In this paper, we construct a one-dimensional photonic quasicrystal by combining two incommensurate spatial harmonics, where the ratio of their periods is the irrational number β \beta . We evaluate the photonic quasicrystal accurately by a generalized spectral method that embeds the quasiperiodic structure into a higher-dimensional periodic system.

arxiv-2603-19848.creator: Panna Gehér, Dömötör Pálvölgyi, Dániel G. Simon, Géza Tóth

pmc-10716948.title: “I can’t imagine having to do it on your own”: a qualitative study on postoperative transitions in care from the perspectives of older adults with frailty
pmc-10716948.creator: Emily Hladkowicz, Mohammad Auais, Gurlavine Kidd, Daniel I McIsaac, Jordan Miller
pmc-10716948.description: BackgroundAdults aged 65 and older have surgery more often than younger people and often live with frailty. The postoperative transition in care from hospital to home after surgey is a challenging time for older adults with frailty as they often experience negative outcomes. Improving postoperative transitions in care for older adults with frailty is a priority.

pmc-10774566.title: Natural history of coronary stents: 14 year follow-up of drug eluting stents versus bare metal stents
pmc-10774566.creator: Rohit Sunil Walse, Krishna Kumar Mohanan Nair, Ajitkumar Valaparambil, Bijulal Sasidharan, Harikrishnan Sivadasapillai, Jissa Vinoda Thulaseedharan
pmc-10774566.description: BackgroundSeveral randomized trials have shown the effectiveness of drug-eluting stents (DES) over bare metal stents (BMS) in terms of repeat revascularization at 1 year; however long term data in this context is conflicting.AimTo assess the long term clinical outcomes after coronary artery stenting with drug-eluting stents and bare metal stents.

pmc-11394068.title: Characterization of the Coding Sequence of the MC1R (Melanocortin 1 Receptor) Gene of Ayam Cemani Black Chickens
pmc-11394068.creator: Beata Horecka, Witold Wojciechowski, Kamil Drabik, Karolina Wengerska, Justyna Batkowska, Chunqi Gao
pmc-11394068.description: Simple SummaryThe genetic background of color is a very complex issue in both birds and mammals. Color-related genes may be represented by multiple alleles and show many interactions. Black chicken breeds are special due to their solid uniform pigmentation, which in the case of Ayam Cemani also concerns the bones and skin.

pmc-11454586.title: 8046 Milk Provision as a Potential Intervention to Improve Iodine Status in a Pregnant Cohort in Northern Ireland (NI), UK: A Randomised Controlled Trial
pmc-11454586.creator: L R Kayes, K R Mullan, J V Woodside
pmc-11454586.description: Disclosure: L.R. Kayes: None. K.R. Mullan: None. J.V. Woodside: None.Iodine deficiency is the leading cause of reversible mental retardation worldwide. During pregnancy there is ∼50% increase in iodine requirement for foetal neurodevelopment. The most recently studied cohorts of pregnant women across Ireland and UK consistently demonstrated mild iodine deficiency (target median urinary iodine concentration (mUIC) ≥150 µg/L).

pmc-11619734.title: Biological strategies in rotator cuff repair: a clinical application and molecular background
pmc-11619734.creator: Maciej Pawlak, Joanna Wałecka, Przemysław Lubiatowski
pmc-11619734.description: Conventional repair of rotator cuff tears bears a variable but significant risk of incomplete healing.Biological therapies that accompany surgical rotator cuff repair include platelet-rich plasma, stem cells of different origins, and biological scaffolds.Biological therapies facilitate the regeneration of the correct microarchitecture of the tendon attachment to the bone and reduce failures after surgical rotator cuff repair.

pmc-11640909.title: Relating visual and pictorial space: Integration of binocular disparity and motion parallax
pmc-11640909.creator: Xiaoye Michael Wang, Nikolaus F. Troje
pmc-11640909.description: Traditionally, perceptual spaces are defined by the medium through which the visual environment is conveyed (e.g., in a physical environment, through a picture, or on a screen). This approach overlooks the distinct contributions of different types of visual information, such as binocular disparity and motion parallax, that transform different visual environments to yield different perceptual spaces.

pmc-12430099.title: The Use of Computational Approaches to Design Nanodelivery Systems
pmc-12430099.creator: Abedalrahman Abughalia, Mairead Flynn, Paul F A Clarke, Darren Fayne, Oliviero L Gobbo, Gregory M Odegard
pmc-12430099.description: Nano-based drug delivery systems present a promising approach to improve the efficacy and safety of therapeutics by enabling targeted drug transport and controlled release. In parallel, computational approaches—particularly Molecular Dynamics (MD) simulations and Artificial Intelligence (AI)—have emerged as transformative tools to accelerate nanocarrier design and optimise their properties.

pmc-12451094.title: Effect of pH on Lipid Oxidation and Anthocyanin Stability in Flaxseed Oil‐in‐Water Emulsions With Black Carrot Extract
pmc-12451094.creator: Evelyn Klinger, Hanna Salminen, Karola Bause, Jochen Weiss
pmc-12451094.description: The strong pH sensitivity and the activity toward free radical reactions limit the use of anthocyanins as food colorants in emulsion‐based food applications. The aim of this study was to gain a comprehensive understanding of color stability of anthocyanin‐rich black carrot extracts in ω‐3 fatty acid–rich oil‐in‐water emulsions as a function of pH.

pmc-12653645.title: Composition of the Gut Microbiome and Its Response to Rice Stripe Virus Infection in Laodelphax striatellus (Hemiptera: Delphacidae)
pmc-12653645.creator: Zhipeng Huang, Lu Zhang, Yu Tian, Jiayi Gao, Fang Liu, Yao Li, Hongyu Zhang, Xiaoxue Li
pmc-12653645.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Simple SummaryThis study investigates the composition and abundance of gut microorganisms in the small brown planthopper and how they respond to infection with rice stripe virus. The results show that the gut microorganisms of the small brown planthopper are mainly composed of bacteria from three major phyla, which is similar to other insects, but the detailed composition at the genus level is different.

pmc-13173892.title: Selection of revision technique for suboptimal total cavopulmonary connection based on computational fluid dynamics: a case report
pmc-13173892.creator: Satoshi Matsuo, Chiharu Ota, Hideki Ota, Yoshikatsu Saiki
pmc-13173892.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). BackgroundUnequal pulmonary blood flow in Fontan circulation is a known contributor to development of pulmonary arteriovenous fistula (PAVF). However, optimal revision strategies remain debated, especially in patients with a pedicled autologous pericardial conduit.Case presentationA 23-year-old woman with a history of pulmonary atresia and previous total cavopulmonary connection (TCPC) using a pedicled pericardial extracardiac lateral tunnel developed hemoptysis and cyanosis due to left-sided PAVF.

pmc-13293367.title: Context Memory Discrimination and Recognition in Humans: Development of a Novel Cognitive Task
pmc-13293367.creator: Sonalee Arun Joshi, Rachel John, Ivy Fei Tso, Carly A Lasagna, Amanda Hicks, Craig Stark, Shauna Stark, Anthony King, James Abelson, Elizabeth R Duval, Israel Liberzon, Javad Sarvestan

pmc-13358512.title: Association of mean blood glucose, glycemic variability, and their combined effect with 28-day mortality in critically ill ICU patients with acute myocardial infarction: a MIMIC-IV retrospective cohort study
pmc-13358512.creator: Xinlin Luo, Jun Zhou, Fenghuan Hu, Dongzhou Liu
pmc-13358512.description: BackgroundDysglycemia is frequent in critically ill patients with acute myocardial infarction (AMI) and is linked to adverse outcomes. However, the relative contributions of sustained hyperglycemia and short-term glucose fluctuations, as well as their combined effects, remain incompletely defined in the intensive care unit (ICU).

pmc-13604099.title: Chemokine-Driven Intercellular Crosstalk in the Osteosarcoma Microenvironment After Neoadjuvant Chemotherapy: A Single-Cell RNA Sequencing Study
pmc-13604099.creator: Bangmin Wang, Jingyu Hou, Qilong Su, Jun Li, Weitao Yao
pmc-13604099.description: Background/Objectives: Osteosarcoma (OS) is an aggressive bone malignancy with a complex tumor microenvironment (TME) that influences therapeutic outcomes and resistance. How neoadjuvant chemotherapy (NACT) reshapes the OS TME at single-cell resolution remains largely undefined. This study aimed to characterize cellular heterogeneity in the OS TME after NACT and identify chemokine-mediated intercellular crosstalk driving chemoresistance.
